reviews.name: Armina Scherlin
reviews.text:
Selyamin Aleykum ben Hollanda dan gecen hafta Almanya sehrinde Frankfurt turk federasyon camisindeydim ve Aksam Namazi na Etistim kilmak icin ve HOCCA yi gordum ve dedim ona abdest alcam ve Namaza gecicem oda dedi ki bekleris sizi Ama malesef sozunde durmadi ve yalan soyledi ,yani anican yalancidir
Bende anayamadim SOFI MI ALEVI BILMEM NE once hooca olmayi orensin ondan sonra namaz kilsin E SELYAMI ALEYKUM
reviews.textTranslated:
Assalamu Alaikum. I am from the Netherlands. Last week I was in Frankfurt, Germany, at the Turkish Federation Mosque. I went to the Evening Prayer and saw the Imam. I told him I would perform ablution and then pray. He said he would wait for me. But unfortunately, he didn't keep his word and lied. In short, he is a liar.
I don't know if he's a Sufi or an Alevi or what. He should learn to be an Imam first, then pray. Assalamu Alaikum.

reviews.name: Mustafa Arif Demir
reviews.text: Eine ganz normale saubere Gebetstätte wo zum barmherzigen Allah beten kann wenn es nicht passt kann auch in anderen Gotteshäusern Mescids beten gehen aber man macht keine Gebetstetten schlecht aufgrund eines Bildes oder sonstigen erst Kopf einschalten und dann schreiben.
reviews.textTranslated: A perfectly normal, clean place of worship where one can pray to the merciful Allah. If it doesn't suit you, you can also pray in other mosques, but you don't criticize prayer places based on a picture or anything else. Think before you write.

reviews.name: Ismail Yildiz
